decisions.reason: This secure second-channel product sits at the heart of our existing authentication and communication know-how, so our strong related knowledge and R&D make it easier to refine and integrate rather than exit.

A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is highly consistent with our core cryptography, platform, and infrastructure capabilities, which gives us strong absorptive capacity to improve and commercialize it further.

The hardware signature token is related to our identity, signing, and hardware experience, but its more niche hardware-based positioning versus the market shift toward app-centric solutions raises the risk of withdrawal.

The payment security compliance suite is somewhat more specialized than our core identity stack, yet it still builds on our transaction authorization and regulatory-security expertise, so we would be more likely to retain than drop it.
